name: Poison Gas
doc: Poison Gas (enemy attacks 32 to 34, Tri-Face's): the caster redrawn under a scrolling gas tint, gas puffs and wisps blown out of it, two cloud meshes drifting across the screen, gas at every target, a screen flash rising and falling; the sound; the damage to every target at tick 30. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag171_poison_gas.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particle tables and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The director's ticks: the sound, each part's start, the damage to every target, the end; the screen flash; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Tinted caster
parts.doc: The caster redrawn with a scrolling gas face over each of its faces, its grey rising then falling

parts.title: Puffs
parts.doc: Gas puffs thrown out of the caster's effect point along its spawn table's rows, growing, slowing

parts.title: Wisps
parts.doc: Thinner gas wisps thrown the same way along other rows (their flipbook played twice as fast)

parts.title: Clouds
parts.doc: Two cloud meshes on the screen drifting sideways, spinning, fading in and out

parts.title: Target gas
parts.doc: Still gas particles appearing around every target's body
